<b>Głos wbrew linii nie jest zdradą ani: A vote against the party line is neither betrayal nor courage — it is a fact. It can be a matter of conscience, a mis-press at the desk, a conscience vote released from the whip, or simple inattention. This table says one thing only: how often a member ended up on the other side from the majority of their party.
<b>Linia klubowa</b> to najczęstszy głos: The party line is the party’s most frequent vote in a given division among “for”, “against” and “abstain”. Absence is not a position — it enters neither the line nor the denominator. That has its own page.

<b>Nic się tu nie uruchamia samo i nic n: Nothing here runs by itself and nothing is sent anywhere. This is a snapshot taken while the page was built. Periods are counted backwards from the most recent data point, not from today — otherwise “the last seven days” would be empty every time the Sejm was not sitting.
<b>Niezrzeszeni są wyłączeni.</b> To nie: Independents are excluded. That is not a party but the absence of one — measuring their discipline is a category error. The first run gave them a 25% “rebellion” rate.
<b>Niezrzeszeni są wyłączeni</b> — nie s: Independents are excluded — they are not a party and have no line.
<b>Podpis</b> to pole <code>author</code: A signature is the author field on a reply in the Sejm API, filled in by hand in ministry offices. The same person appears in a dozen spellings, so we split each signature into office and name and merge the variants.
<b>Prolongata nie wydłuża terminu.</b> R: An extension notice does not extend the deadline. The Rules provide for no extension; a notice of delay is counted separately as a signal, not as an excuse.
<b>Przemianowanie klubu nie jest transfe: Renaming a party is not a defection. We treat a move as a renaming when it carries at least 90% of everyone who ever voted under the old name, on a single day, into a name that did not exist before. Forty PiS members joining RozwojPlus is 19% of the party, so it stays a defection.

<b>To nie jest formalna lista Rady Minis: This is not the formal roster of the Council of Ministers. No API carries one. The President’s appointment decisions are published in Monitor Polski, but the names sit in the PDF alone, so the metadata yields a date and a link, never a membership. This page shows something else, and something checkable: who actually answers parliament on a ministry’s behalf. A secretary of state who signs a thousand replies is not the minister — they are the person through whom the ministry talks to the Sejm.
<b>To nie jest zapis tego, co było wiado: This is not a record of what was known in that month. A report from a year ago looks different from how it would have looked then — some replies arrived later and today we see them as given. It is today’s view of that period, not a snapshot from the time.
<b>Usprawiedliwienie to status formalny,: An excuse is a formal status, not a judgement on the merits — and it covers a whole sitting day, not a single vote. The API states whether a day was excused but gives no reason: a foreign delegation, sick leave and parental leave are indistinguishable in the data. A high share of unexcused absences settles nothing beyond the fact that the Chancellery recorded no excuse.
<b>Vacatio legis</b> = data wejścia w ży: Vacatio legis = the date of entry into force minus the date of promulgation in the Journal of Laws. Both come from the entryIntoForce and promulgation fields of the ELI API.
<b>Średni czas</b> to liczba dni od prze: The average time is the number of days from the question reaching the addressee to the reply arriving, weighted by signature count. It measures the ministry’s pace while that person was signing, not their personal efficiency.
